summary: OpenAI announced that Samsung Electronics will deploy ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to all its employees in Korea and to all Device eXperience division employees worldwide.

mechanisms.reason: A company-wide rollout to all Samsung Electronics employees in Korea plus a global division is described as one of OpenAI's largest enterprise deployments, materially increasing aggregate token volume.
mechanisms.quote: This represents one of OpenAI’s largest enterprise deployments to date.

notable_reason: A deployment of this scale at a major global electronics manufacturer is a meaningful data point on enterprise AI adoption volume even though it carries no new capability, pricing or infrastructure information.
